description.value: Craft Cafe is a neighbourhood cafe and cocktail bar on Quayside Drive along the New Westminster waterfront of the Fraser River. It serves single-origin espresso from The Barn, a Berlin roastery recognized internationally for specialty coffee, alongside food including grilled cheese sandwiches and pasta. A hidden backroom speakeasy—The Back Room—offers craft cocktails and riverfront views in an adults-only lounge tucked behind the main cafe.
